# Smart meter: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Readings must be sent over an encrypted channel, per Energy Security Code 3. |
| C2 | Readings must carry a signature so tampering is detectable, per Energy Security Code 4. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a resident, I want to see my usage by hour so that I can shift demand.
US-2 As a utility engineer, I want to update meter firmware remotely so that I avoid site visits.
US-3 As a utility engineer, I want each reading encrypted in transit and signed at source so that nothing can be read or altered on the way.
constraints: Readings must be sent over an encrypted channel, per Energy Security Code 3.
Readings must carry a signature so tampering is detectable, per Energy Security Code 4.
